links.outcome: LLM accuracy vs physician reviewer and earlier LLM in identifying higher-acuity patient
links.effect: GPT-4 accuracy 0.89 vs comparator LLM 0.84 (10,000 pairs); in 500-pair subsample LLM 0.88 vs physician reviewer 0.86.
links.quote: Among the 500-pair subsample that was also manually classified, LLM performance (accuracy, 0.88 [95% CI, 0.86-0.91]) was comparable with that of the physician reviewer (accuracy, 0.86 [95% CI, 0.83-0.89]).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (GPT-4 vs GPT-3.5 and physician comparison) on retrospective clinical notes to assess acuity in the emergency department without testing specific deployment safeguards or practices.
